aboutIntro: Izinqumlo zekhibhodi, izifundo, uluntu nokunye ukukunceda ufunde kwaye ukhulise i-HAX.
haxDescription: I-HAX yinkqubo yokubhala esekelwe kwiwebhu eyilelwe ukupapasha umxholo ofikelelekayo nonamacandelo kwiimeko ezininzi zokuhambisa.
keyboardShortcutsDescription: Zibhaliswe embindini kwi-HAXcms kwaye ziboniswa ngokwemeko esebenzayo. Ukubopha kusebenzisa Ctrl+Shift+[Key]; kumhleli, ukuchwetheza isiqalisi se-markdown emva koko isithuba kuguqula ibhloko. Chwetheza u-{slash} kwibhloko yombhalo engenanto ukuvula uKhangelo olungaphakathi.
tutorialsDescription: Qala ngemisebenzi ekhokelwayo, uze uqhubele kwizifundo zenyathelo ngenyathelo.
apiLinksDescription: I-HAXcms inokupapasha amaphepha ngeefomathi ezilungele oomatshini ukuze izixhobo ze-LLM zifunde kwaye ziqhubekise umxholo wakho ngokucoca okuncinci.
apiLinksFormats: Yongeza {formats} kwii-URL zamaphepha ukucela ezinye iziphumo zephepha.
apiLinksLlms: Sebenzisa {llms} njengesalathiso esijongene nemodeli sale sayithi, esinamakhonkco kwizixhobo eziphambili ezifundeka ngoomatshini.
apiLinksPair: Dibanisa {siteJson} (ulwakhiwo) no-{searchIndex} (ukufumana) ukuze ufumane iinkqubo ezomeleleyo ezixhaswa yi-AI.
